findings.issue: Retained immutable orphan revisions are not charged to content/file limits after reopen.

reproduction.method: Actual publisher module and original labelled receipt helper; private temporary filesystem only. Injected catalog rename failure after immutable directory rename, restored fs.rename, reopened, published unrelated receipt. All temp removed; no source edits.

findings.repair: Preserve exact orphan receipt recovery, but block unrelated writes until reconciliation or validate/charge every retained immutable directory against bounded quotas.

qualificationNote: Sandbox removes document storage/cookie access and service supplies no credentials. It does not force omit on arbitrary generated HTTPS fetch(credentials:include); browser evidence explicitly used omit and empty cookie context. Avoid claiming universal ambient network credential stripping absent supported credentialless boundary.
